title: Multi-tenant QA auditing and mobile data collection
summary: A recreated SaaS architecture model based on high-volume quality auditing, cross-platform HTML5 mobile data collection, tenant-aware workflows, and operational reporting.
highlights: HTML5 cross-platform mobile data collection model
Tenant-aware application and audit workflow concepts
Reporting overhead reduction from logical reporting layer

title: Replayable vendor API ingestion and reporting layer
summary: A generalized data platform pattern showing efficient vendor API consumption, SharePoint Online caching, multi-tenant integration, and reporting design without sacrificing recovery or auditability.
highlights: Reduced repetitive object pulls with idempotent API consumer
Performance-tuned query shapes for reporting and ingestion workloads
Multi-tenant integration and reporting layer across vendor and ops data

title: Corporate website and Portmason platform experience
summaryHtml: www.etal.solutions is a modern corporate website built as a fast, data-driven static experience that unifies services, brands, thought leadership, and the Portmason Platform within a maintainable publishing and deployment model.
highlights: Self-registering catalog architecture for services, brands, promotions, and platform content
Containerized local development with repeatable Portmason setup, rendering, and deployment workflows
High-performance static delivery through GitHub Pages with modular content, responsive navigation, and environment-driven configuration
